name: 2C-RT
title: 2C-RT Quantifies Genome-Wide DNA Replication Perturbations and Redefines RIF1-CDC7 Regulation of Replication Timing
summary: Replication timing from EdU-labelled S-phase cells sorted by a cell-cycle marker and DNA content, with multiplexed EdU-seq.
needs_review: labels inferred from Fig. 2 only; confirm chemistry

name: 3C
title: Capturing chromosome conformation
summary: Chromosome conformation capture: crosslink, digest and ligate, then quantify ligation between chosen loci. The ancestor of the C-family.

name: 4C-seq
title: Robust 4C-seq data analysis to screen for regulatory DNA interactions
summary: Inverse-PCR from a single viewpoint to sequence all of its ligation partners (one-vs-all).

name: ATAC-seq
title: Transposition of native chromatin for fast and sensitive epigenomic profiling of open chromatin, DNA-binding proteins and nucleosome position
summary: Tn5 transposase inserts sequencing adapters into accessible chromatin.

name: Capture-C
title: Analysis of hundreds of cis-regulatory landscapes at high resolution in a single, high-throughput experiment
summary: 3C library enriched with capture oligonucleotides to profile one-vs-all contacts from many viewpoints at once.

name: ChIA-PET
title: An oestrogen-receptor-alpha-bound human chromatin interactome
summary: Chromatin interactions anchored at sites bound by a chosen protein, via ChIP plus paired-end-tag ligation.

name: ChIP-seq
title: Genome-wide mapping of in vivo protein-DNA interactions
summary: Chromatin immunoprecipitation followed by sequencing to map protein binding or histone marks genome-wide.

name: ChIPmentation
title: ChIPmentation: fast, robust, low-input ChIP-seq for histones and transcription factors
summary: ChIP-seq with Tn5 tagmentation of bead-bound chromatin for fast, low-input library prep.

name: CUT&RUN
title: An efficient targeted nuclease strategy for high-resolution mapping of DNA binding sites
summary: Antibody-tethered pA-MNase cleaves around bound sites in permeabilised cells; low background, low input.

name: CUT&Tag
title: CUT&Tag for efficient epigenomic profiling of small samples and single cells
summary: Antibody-tethered pA-Tn5 tagments only at bound sites in permeabilised cells, giving low-background profiles from few cells.

name: Dip-C
title: Three-dimensional genome structures of single diploid human cells
summary: Single-cell Hi-C with transposon-based whole-genome amplification and haplotype imputation for diploid 3D structures.

name: DNase-seq
title: High-resolution mapping and characterization of open chromatin across the genome
summary: DNase I hypersensitive sites sequenced genome-wide to map open chromatin.

name: Drop-seq
title: Highly Parallel Genome-wide Expression Profiling of Individual Cells Using Nanoliter Droplets
summary: Cells co-encapsulated with barcoded beads in droplets, giving thousands of single-cell transcriptomes per run.

name: Droplet Hi-C
title: Droplet Hi-C enables scalable, single-cell profiling of chromatin architecture in heterogeneous tissues
summary: In situ Hi-C followed by droplet barcoding on a commercial 10x scATAC kit for tens of thousands of cells per run.

name: Droplet Paired-Tag
title: Droplet-based single-cell joint profiling of histone modifications and transcriptomes
summary: Paired-Tag chemistry moved onto commercial droplet microfluidics for higher throughput and simpler workflow.

name: ECHOS
aliases: ECHOS+; Epigenetic CUT&Tag via High-resolution Optical Selection
title: ECHOS enables spatial epigenome profiling at subcellular resolution
summary: CUT&Tag on optically selected regions of tissue or nuclei, giving spatially targeted epigenomic profiles down to sub-micron scale.

name: FAIRE-seq
title: FAIRE (Formaldehyde-Assisted Isolation of Regulatory Elements) isolates active regulatory elements from human chromatin
summary: Nucleosome-depleted DNA partitions to the aqueous phase after crosslinking and phenol-chloroform extraction.

name: GAGE-seq
title: GAGE-seq concurrently profiles multiscale 3D genome organization and gene expression in single cells
summary: Combinatorial-indexing joint profiling of chromatin conformation and transcriptome in single cells.

name: GAM
title: Complex multi-enhancer contacts captured by genome architecture mapping
summary: Ligation-free co-segregation mapping from sequencing thin nuclear cryosections.

name: Hi-C
title: Comprehensive mapping of long-range interactions reveals folding principles of the human genome
summary: Genome-wide all-vs-all chromatin contact mapping by restriction digest, biotin fill-in and proximity ligation.

name: HiChIP
title: HiChIP: efficient and sensitive analysis of protein-directed genome architecture
summary: In situ Hi-C followed by ChIP and Tn5 library prep to enrich protein-anchored contacts from low input.

name: HiRES
title: Linking genome structures to functions by simultaneous single-cell Hi-C and RNA-seq
summary: Simultaneous single-cell Hi-C and RNA-seq from the same cell.

name: in situ Hi-C
title: A 3D map of the human genome at kilobase resolution reveals principles of chromatin looping
summary: Hi-C with digestion and ligation performed in intact nuclei, giving kilobase-resolution maps and loop calls.

name: Methyl-HiC
title: Joint profiling of DNA methylation and chromatin architecture in single cells
summary: In situ Hi-C combined with bisulfite conversion to read contacts and methylation together.

name: Micro-C
title: Mapping Nucleosome Resolution Chromosome Folding in Yeast by Micro-C
summary: Hi-C variant using MNase instead of restriction enzymes for nucleosome-resolution contact maps.

name: Micro-Capture-C
title: Defining genome architecture at base-pair resolution
summary: MNase-based Capture-C with ligation junctions read directly, giving near base-pair resolution one-vs-all contact profiles.

name: NG Capture-C
title: Multiplexed analysis of chromosome conformation at vastly improved sensitivity
summary: Capture-C with double capture and multiplexing for much higher sensitivity per viewpoint.

name: Paired Hi-C
chemistry: restriction-digest; proximity-ligation; tn5; droplet-microfluidics; facs-sorting; reverse-transcription
title: Droplet Hi-C enables scalable, single-cell profiling of chromatin architecture in heterogeneous tissues
summary: Droplet Hi-C adapted to the 10x Multiome kit to profile chromatin conformation and transcriptome from the same nucleus. Introduced in the Results section, not the abstract.

name: Paired-seq
title: An ultra high-throughput method for single-cell joint analysis of open chromatin and transcriptome
summary: Combinatorial-indexing joint profiling of chromatin accessibility and transcriptome in single nuclei.

name: Paired-Tag
title: Joint profiling of histone modifications and transcriptome in single cells from mouse brain
summary: Antibody-guided Tn5 tagmentation plus combinatorial indexing for joint histone-mark and transcriptome profiles per nucleus.

name: PLAC-seq
title: Mapping of long-range chromatin interactions by proximity ligation-assisted ChIP-seq
summary: Proximity ligation in nuclei followed by ChIP to capture contacts anchored at marked or bound regions.

name: Pore-C
title: Identifying synergistic high-order 3D chromatin conformations from genome-scale nanopore concatemer sequencing
summary: Chromatin conformation capture with nanopore reads of full concatemers, capturing multi-way contacts.

name: RCMC
title: Region Capture Micro-C reveals coalescence of enhancers and promoters into nested microcompartments
summary: Micro-C library enriched for selected regions, giving deep all-vs-all contact maps within them.

name: RNA-seq
title: Mapping and quantifying mammalian transcriptomes by RNA-Seq
summary: High-throughput sequencing of cDNA to quantify the transcriptome.

name: scATAC-seq
title: Single-cell chromatin accessibility reveals principles of regulatory variation
summary: ATAC-seq performed on individual cells captured in microfluidic chambers.

name: scBS-seq
title: Single-cell genome-wide bisulfite sequencing for assessing epigenetic heterogeneity
summary: Post-bisulfite adaptor tagging to profile genome-wide DNA methylation in single cells.

name: sci-ATAC-seq
title: Multiplex single cell profiling of chromatin accessibility by combinatorial cellular indexing
summary: First combinatorial-indexing single-cell method: barcoded Tn5 plus PCR indexing across plates.

name: sci-CAR
title: Joint profiling of chromatin accessibility and gene expression in thousands of single cells
summary: Combinatorial indexing for joint chromatin accessibility and transcriptome from the same cells.

name: sci-Hi-C
title: Massively multiplex single-cell Hi-C
summary: Single-cell Hi-C scaled to thousands of cells by combinatorial cellular indexing.

name: sci-RNA-seq
title: Comprehensive single-cell transcriptional profiling of a multicellular organism
summary: Single-cell transcriptomes by combinatorial cellular indexing, no physical isolation of cells.

name: scNanoHi-C
title: scNanoHi-C: a single-cell long-read concatemer sequencing method to reveal high-order chromatin structures within individual cells
summary: Single-cell Hi-C read on nanopore so whole ligation concatemers (multi-way contacts) are sequenced.

name: SeqTag
title: The molecular asynchrony of single cells
summary: Single-cell multiomics: antibody-targeted CUT&Tag (histone marks) + ATAC (accessibility) + RNA from the same cell, with plate-based combinatorial barcoding. Named in the abstract only, not the title.

name: SHARE-seq
title: Chromatin Potential Identified by Shared Single-Cell Profiling of RNA and Chromatin
summary: Split-pool ligation barcoding of accessibility and transcriptome from the same single cells.

name: single-cell Hi-C
title: Single-cell Hi-C reveals cell-to-cell variability in chromosome structure
summary: Hi-C performed in individually isolated nuclei to measure contacts in single cells.

name: single-cell RNA-seq
title: mRNA-Seq whole-transcriptome analysis of a single cell
summary: First whole-transcriptome sequencing of a single cell (manually picked cells, plate-based cDNA amplification).

name: sn-m3C-seq
title: Simultaneous profiling of 3D genome structure and DNA methylation in single human cells
summary: Joint chromatin conformation and DNA methylome from the same single nucleus via bisulfite conversion of 3C libraries.

name: SNARE-seq
title: High-throughput sequencing of the transcriptome and chromatin accessibility in the same cell
summary: Droplet-based joint profiling of accessibility and transcriptome by capturing tagmented DNA alongside mRNA.

name: snmC-seq
title: Single-cell methylomes identify neuronal subtypes and regulatory elements in mammalian cortex
summary: Single-nucleus methylome sequencing with improved throughput, used to classify neuronal subtypes.

name: SPRITE
title: Higher-Order Inter-chromosomal Hubs Shape 3D Genome Organization in the Nucleus
summary: Ligation-free mapping of multi-way interactions by split-pool barcoding of crosslinked complexes.

name: Tiled-MCC
title: Analysis of sub-kilobase chromatin topology reveals nano-scale regulatory interactions with variable dependence on cohesin and CTCF
summary: Micro-Capture-C with oligos tiled across a whole region, giving all-vs-all contacts within the captured locus.

name: TOPmentation
title: MLL-AF4 cooperates with PAF1 and FACT to drive high-density enhancer interactions in leukemia
summary: Optimised high-throughput ChIPmentation for weakly bound non-histone proteins from ~100,000 cells. Named only in the Results section.

name: WGBS
title: Human DNA methylomes at base resolution show widespread epigenomic differences
summary: Bisulfite conversion plus whole-genome sequencing to map DNA methylation at single-base resolution.
